Data from September 2024 (opening month) refer to visits to Jurong Lake Gardens which includes Lakeside Garden, Chinese Garden and Japanese Garden Jurong Lake Gardens was opened on 8 September 2024.  Data prior to September 2024 refer to visits to Chinese/Japanese Gardens. Chinese/Japanese Gardens was closed for redevelopment from 1 June 2019 to 7 September 2024.  From October 2002 to July 2007, Japanese Gardens was closed for renovation.  Data for 2019 refer to visits to Chinese/ Japanese Gardens from 1 January to 31 May 2019.  From April 2016, data are obtained from National Parks Board.  Prior to April 2016, data were obtained from JTC Corporation.

Visitorship to the museums is counted using an automatic tracking system, which makes use of tracking devices fixed at all the entrances to the museums.  All visitors who access the museum premises are captured in the count, regardless of whether the entries are based on paid admissions or those not requiring payment.  Children's Museum Singapore was formerly known as the Singapore Philatelic Museum.  Children's Museum Singapore was opened on 10 December 2022.  Prior to Apr 2025, data on visitorship to Children's Museum Singapore (CMSG), Changi Chapel and Museum (CCM) and Reflections at Bukit Chandu (RBC) were provided by the National Heritage Board.  From Apr 2025, data on visitorship to CMSG, CCM and RBC are provided by HeritageSG.

Opened in January 1996.  With effect from April 2006, visitorship to the museums is counted using an automatic tracking system, a device which is fixed at entrances to the museums.  All visitors who access the museum premises are captured in the count, regardless of whether the entries are based on paid admissions or those not requiring payment.  Visitorship data include visitors to SAM at 8Q which was officially opened on 15 August 2008.  Singapore Art Museum (SAM) had been incorporated as an independent company limited by guarantee in November 2013.  From January 2014, visitorship data are provided by SAM.  SAM at the former St. Joseph's Institution building closed for redevelopment works in September 2018.  Data for 2019 refer to visitorship to SAM at 8Q from 1 January to 28 February 2019.  SAM at 8Q closed for redevelopment in March 2019.  SAM opened its new venue at Tanjong Pagar Distripark in January 2022.  Visitorship from 2022 include visitors to Tanjong Pagar Distripark only.  Data exclude digital visitorship.
